spec.name: Orange Kitchen Takeaway Bag
spec.description: Open kraft takeaway bag with folded rims, inset side gussets, angular twisted-paper handles and a raised orange fruit emblem. Warm paper shading and connected creases keep the silhouette readable in inventory.

prompt: Orange SMP Kitchen cohesive premium Minecraft vanilla voxel art. Appetizing recognizable silhouette and deliberate connected pixel shading, material detail and highlights. No plain untextured cubes, random noise, letters or scenery. Use ONE well-mapped 64x64 atlas; per-face UV islands, not repeated generic material tiles. Keep texture palette cohesive: warm golden bread, fresh greens, ivory rice, rich salmon, warm ceramics. Geometry should be carefully stepped and rounded where appropriate, with purposeful tiny details. 20-55 cuboids as appropriate, stay within Java model bounds -16..32. Item ground bottom y0. Strong inventory readability. Create Takeaway Bag. Folded kraft paper takeaway bag with twisted handles, creased paper, orange fruit logo without text, open upper edge.
